changes: Root cause confirmed and fixed: FIREBASE_DB_SECRET had accidentally been set to the service account's private key rather than the real Realtime Database secret. The real secret does exist for this project — it just wasn't visible on Firebase console's mobile view, only found by switching to desktop. With the correct value now in place, reverted blackjack-table-dealer.mjs's brief detour into OAuth2/service-account authentication back to the same simple, proven DB_SECRET pattern every other function in this project already uses. No new env vars needed — just the corrected FIREBASE_DB_SECRET value already in place on Netlify.
